children: Experienced Real Estate Executive to Lead Robo Agent's Planned Q4 2026 Rollout and Regional Sales Expansion
("Mitesco" or the "Company"), through its Vero Technology Ventures division, today announced the appointment of Salvatore "Sal" Carillo as National Sales Manager.

Carillo will lead the national sales strategy and planned Q4 2026 rollout of Robo Agent, Mitesco's AI-powered real estate productivity platform, as well as its other software development projects. His responsibilities will include developing regional sales operations initially focused on the Northeast, West Coast and Southeast, while building relationships with specific licensing opportunities through brokerages, real estate teams, industry coaches and other strategic partners.

"Sal combines hands-on real estate experience with a strong understanding of how agents and brokerages operate," said Brian Valania, Chief Executive Officer of Mitesco, Inc. "That perspective will be important as we move Robo Agent from product development into broader market deployment and establish experienced regional sales teams across the country."

Carillo currently serves as Managing Director of Mayell Real Estate in the New York City metropolitan area. His role with Vero has been structured to allow him to continue operating his real estate business, keeping him directly connected to agents, clients and changing market conditions.
In addition to Robo Agent, Carillo will oversee sales development for other projects currently under consideration by the Company.

Mitesco intends for its customer-facing Robo Agent sales professionals to be licensed real estate agents with at least 10 years of industry experience. The Company believes this experience-based sales model will enable its representatives to better understand the daily challenges facing agents and demonstrate how Robo Agent can improve productivity, follow-up, accountability and business growth. "Robo Agent is being built around the way successful real estate professionals actually work," said Carillo. "I look forward to helping assemble an experienced national sales organization and introducing the platform to agents, teams and brokerages beginning in the fourth quarter."

As Vero evaluates potential licensing candidates and complementary technologies, Mitesco may consider flexible transaction structures designed to address the capital constraints that can affect emerging companies. Valania noted “As a publicly held Company we have some growth opportunities not generally available to other technology entities. These structures may include cash, equity or a combination of both, including the potential of Mitesco taking an equity interest in a licensing candidate, or a candidate taking a minority equity position in Mitesco.” Any such transaction would be subject to due diligence, definitive agreements, required corporate approvals and applicable securities laws. No specific transactions are in discussion at this time.

Robo Agent is an AI-powered real estate productivity platform designed to help agents identify priorities, manage opportunities, improve follow-up execution and drive better business outcomes.
